_note: Feature tables for the space opera classes. n = feature name, d = one-line rules text the DM treats as authoritative.

1.d: Casts sorcerer-list spells as Powers using CHA; needs no material focus.
Advantage on Insight and Perception checks against creatures within 30 ft; you sense strong emotions.

2.d: Regain one expended 1st-level slot on a short rest.

3.d: An invisible telekinetic hand within 30 ft lifts or manipulates objects up to 10 lb.

5.d: 2/rest, cast a cantrip as a bonus action after casting a leveled Power.

7.d: You take no damage from falls; 1/turn, shove a creature 10 ft when a Power damages it.

9.d: Your thoughts cannot be read; you gain +2 to WIS saving throws.

13.d: You have advantage on saving throws to maintain concentration.

15.d: 1/long rest, regain expended slot levels equal to your CHA modifier.

17.d: 1/long rest, your next damaging Power deals maximum damage.

18.d: You are immune to psychic damage and to having your thoughts read.

20.d: 1/long rest, cast a Power of 5th level or lower without spending a slot; choose two targets.

1.d: Bonus action: summon or dismiss a plasma blade, a sword dealing 1d8 radiant damage on hit, for 1 minute.
1/turn, add your CHA modifier as radiant damage to a plasma blade hit.

6.d: When a creature misses you with a melee attack, make one plasma blade attack against it as a reaction.

10.d: While your plasma blade is summoned you gain +1 AC, and it counts as a magical weapon.

14.d: 1/long rest, for 1 minute make one additional plasma blade attack on each of your turns.

1.d: Add your INT modifier to checks made to pilot, repair, or sabotage vehicles and craft.
2/long rest, 10 minutes of work repairs a broken device, weapon, or vehicle.

2.d: Casts wizard-list spells as Protocols using INT; a handheld deck is the focus.
1/rest, sense the cargo, crew, and damage of any craft you can see within 300 ft.

5.d: Once per turn as a bonus action, a vehicle you pilot makes one weapon attack or moves up to half its speed.

6.d: You have advantage on checks to navigate, chart courses, or track sensor signatures.

7.d: While aboard a craft you pilot, allies within 10 ft of you gain +1 AC.

9.d: While piloting, you have advantage on DEX saving throws against area effects.

10.d: 1/short rest, end one condition affecting a vehicle you pilot or one ally aboard it.

11.d: A small drone obeys you: AC 13, HP 10 + your level, flies 30 ft, attacks for 1d6 + INT on your command.

13.d: Patch Job has 4 uses and can repair magical or alien technology.

14.d: Your drone improves to AC 16 and HP 20 + twice your level, and adds your INT modifier to its damage.

15.d: 1/long rest, a vehicle you pilot gains advantage on checks to hide or evade pursuit for 1 hour.

17.d: You can command your drone as a bonus action, and use Co-Pilot Link twice per turn.

18.d: While piloting, you have advantage on INT and WIS saving throws against spells.

20.d: 1/long rest, for 1 minute a vehicle you pilot gains +2 AC and +50 ft speed, and its guns fire without your bonus action.

3.d: Vehicle weapon attacks you make add your INT modifier to damage.
1/short rest, a vehicle you pilot makes one additional weapon attack immediately.

7.d: Vehicles you pilot take half damage from area effects, none on a successful save.

11.d: Co-Pilot Link grants two weapon attacks instead of one.

15.d: 1/long rest, for 1 minute your vehicle's weapon attacks deal +1d6 damage and ignore cover.

1.d: 1/long rest, a short con secures a small favor, forged document, or entry somewhere (DM adjudicates scope).
1/short rest, reroll a failed CHA-based check.

2.d: Double your proficiency bonus in two skills you are proficient with.
Disengage or Hide as a bonus action.

5.d: Quick Con has 2 uses per long rest.

6.d: You always know when a wager or deal is rigged, and can always find a game or a buyer.

7.d: When you roll initiative, move up to half your speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

9.d: 1/long rest, the DM tells you what a person you converse with most wants.

10.d: Double your proficiency bonus in two more proficient skills.

11.d: 1/week, an elaborate con secures something genuinely valuable or dangerous (DM adjudicates scope).

13.d: A creature that accepts your parley cannot attack you until the start of your next turn.

14.d: Winner's Luck recharges to 3 uses per short rest.

15.d: Quick Con has 3 uses per long rest, and favors arrive in half the usual time.

17.d: 1/long rest, reroll any failed attack roll, ability check, or saving throw.

18.d: You and allies within 30 ft add +1d4 to CHA-based checks.

20.d: 1/long rest, one reasonable social or gambling outcome simply succeeds (DM adjudicates scope).

3.d: After 1 minute observing a creature or game, learn one habit, tell, or weakness of it.
Advantage on Deception checks made for money, wagers, or favors.

7.d: Advantage on CHA checks against anyone who has lost a wager or deal to you.

11.d: You always learn when someone nearby is cheating, lying, or asking about you.

15.d: 1/long rest, turn one failed gamble, deal, or CHA check into a partial success.

1.d: Bonus action touch: an ally regains 1d6 + WIS HP. Uses per long rest equal to your WIS modifier.
A handheld scanner reveals a creature's rough HP, conditions, and diseases.

2.d: Casts cleric-list spells as stims using WIS.

5.d: Stabilize a dying creature as a bonus action; creatures you stabilize wake with 1 HP after 1 minute.

7.d: You and allies within 5 ft have advantage on saves against poison and disease.

9.d: An ally you stim can also stand and move half its speed for free.

10.d: 1/long rest, an ally at 0 HP within 30 ft instantly regains 3d6 + WIS HP.

11.d: Stim Gun heals 3d6 + WIS and can be fired as a dart at a range of 30 ft.

13.d: 1/day, regain one expended spell slot of 3rd level or lower on a short rest.

14.d: You and allies within 10 ft have advantage on saves against being frightened.

15.d: While below half HP, regain HP equal to your WIS modifier at the start of your turn (5 rounds per long rest).

17.d: Your healing dice each count as at least half their maximum.

18.d: 1/short rest, touch cures any disease, poison, blindness, deafness, or paralysis.

20.d: 1/week, restore a creature dead less than 1 minute to life at half HP.

3.d: Dash or Disengage as a bonus action when moving toward a downed ally.
While adjacent to a downed ally, attacks against you have disadvantage.

7.d: Carry or drag allies at full speed; allies you heal gain 1d6 temporary HP.

11.d: An ally you heal gains +2 AC until the start of your next turn.

15.d: 1/long rest, an ally within 30 ft that would drop to 0 HP drops to 1 instead.

1.d: You have +1 AC while wearing medium or heavy armor.
1/turn, when you hit with a ranged weapon attack, the target has disadvantage on its next attack roll.

2.d: Bonus action: gain +2 AC against the next attack that hits you before your next turn.

5.d: Attack twice when taking the Attack action.

6.d: Your Siege Frame AC bonus improves to +2 while wearing medium or heavy armor.

7.d: 1/long rest, hurl a demolition charge: creatures in a 10-ft radius make a DEX save or take 3d6 fire damage, half on a success.

9.d: 1/long rest, reroll a failed saving throw.

10.d: 2/long rest, bonus action: a creature within 30 ft must attack you on its next turn (WIS save negates).

11.d: Attack three times when taking the Attack action.

13.d: Reaction: +3 AC against one ranged attack you can see, 3/long rest.

14.d: Advantage on saves against being knocked prone or pushed.

15.d: Advantage on CON saves and resistance to poison damage.

17.d: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19-20.

18.d: 1/long rest while below half HP, bonus action to regain 10 + level HP.

20.d: 1/turn, dropping a foe to 0 HP lets an ally within 30 ft immediately make one weapon attack.

3.d: Heavy ranged weapons lose the loading and two-handed properties for you.
Once per turn, when you miss with a heavy ranged attack, deal half the damage to the target.

7.d: 1/short rest, spray a 10-ft cube within 60 ft: creatures inside make a DEX save or take 2d8 fire damage, half on a success.

11.d: A creature damaged by your heavy weapon attack cannot take reactions until the start of its next turn.

15.d: 1/long rest, for 1 minute gain +2 AC and resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

1.d: Casts wizard-list spells as Star Charts using INT; a starchart or orrery is the focus.
May run any known Star Chart with the ritual tag over 10 minutes without spending a slot.

2.d: 1/rest, chart a point you can see; for 8 hours you know its exact distance and direction.

3.d: Advantage on checks to navigate, read stars, or interpret the Lattice.

5.d: Stores one Star Chart of level 1-3; cast it once without a slot per long rest.

6.d: Reaction, 2/rest: swap places with a willing ally within 30 ft.

9.d: Project your senses to any point you have charted within 1 mile for 10 minutes.

11.d: Your cache holds two charts of level 1-5.

13.d: Learn two Star Charts from any spell list; they count as wizard-list for you.

15.d: Advantage on INT, WIS, and CHA saving throws against spells and psionics.

18.d: 1/long rest, teleport yourself and up to five willing creatures to a point you have charted within 1 mile.

20.d: 1/day, regain 4 expended spell slot levels on a short rest.

2.d: When a creature you can see attacks you, reaction: move 10 ft without provoking; melee attacks then miss if you leave their reach.
1/turn, a damaging Star Chart deals +1d8 radiant damage to one target.

6.d: When you succeed on a saving throw against a spell, deal 2d8 force damage to the caster.

10.d: Your Star Charts score a critical hit on 19-20 against spellcasters and constructs.

14.d: 1/long rest, split one single-target damaging Star Chart among up to three targets.
